categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Enables interprocedural optimization (LTO) in the Alpine CI job to catch C++ One Definition Rule violations with GCC's -Wodr.
categories.rationale: It improves CI detection by enabling LTO in Alpine CI to catch future ODR violations. This adds a helpful build diagnostic job without blocking existing release integrity.
